Container.Name: oppo-music-uc
Container.Overview: Unfolded Circle Remote integration for OPPO Music: browse the music library (artists, albums, tracks, covers and formats) from the remote and play it on the OPPO UDP-205 through the OPPO Music server. Image built locally from /mnt/user/appdata/oppo-music-uc/app (docker build -t oppo-music-uc:VERSION .). Host network: the remote discovers it over mDNS and connects to its WebSocket port.

Config.Name: App
Config.Description: Driver files (driver.json, intg-oppo-music): replace them and restart to update the driver.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Settings saved by the remote's setup (OPPO Music server address).

Config.Name: Listen address
Config.Description: Address of this server on the LAN, announced to the remote over mDNS.

Config.Name: Log level
Config.Description: INFO, or DEBUG to see every message.
